prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1199; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pearland, Texas, near a shopping center. I was in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left lane because my exit was coming up.

Q: What happened when you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror, saw nothing close, and started to move over. Then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed toward the median. The other car had been in my blind spot, I think, and it clipped the side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Not really. I glanced over my shoulder, but I didn't see it until the contact happened.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: I'd guess around the speed limit, maybe a little slower because traffic was heavy.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I hit my head on the side window and I've had headaches since. I also feel foggy and light sensitive. My doctor has told me it's a concussion and I've been advised to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Have you received medical treatment?

A: I was seen at an urgent care clinic the same day and I have a follow-up appointment scheduled with my primary care physician next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I can provide my medical records and photos of the damage whenever you need them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
